gripOrHq.title: Restrictive Net Zoning
gripOrHq.rulesText: Choose a data fort when Restrictive Net Zoning is installed. The Corp must pay [2], in addition to the normal cost, to install ice on that fort.

heapOrArchives.title: Core Command: Jettison Ice
heapOrArchives.rulesText: Play only if you made a successful run on HQ this turn. Pay the rez cost of a piece of rezzed ice to trash it.

scoreArea.title: Corporate War
scoreArea.rulesText: If you have [12] or more bits in your pool when you score Corporate War, gain [12]; otherwise, lose all bits.

scoreArea.title: Hostile Takeover
scoreArea.rulesText: Gain [5] when you score Hostile Takeover.

rig.title: Krash
rig.rulesText:
2 credits: Break ice subroutine.
2 credits: +1 strength.

rig.title: Broker
rig.rulesText: Each of your turns, you may take only one action to use Broker. A: Put [3] from the bank on Broker. A: Take all the bits from Broker.

rig.title: Junkyard BBS
rig.rulesText: A, [1]: Bring the top card from your trash into your hand.

ice.title: Snowbank
ice.rulesText: *End the run unless Runner pays [1]. Gain [3] when you rez Snowbank.

root.title: Tokyo-Chiba Infighting
root.rulesText:
Gain [2] after each unsuccessful run on this fort.
Rez a region when you install it. Install a region only if you can pay to rez it. Only one region may be installed in each fort. Trash older ones.

ice.title: Dog Pile
ice.rulesText: *Do 1 Net damage for each rezzed piece of ice installed outside Dog Pile. *End the run. Dog Pile has +1 strength for each rezzed piece of ice installed outside it.

root.title: Misleading Access Menus
root.rulesText: *End the run unless Runner pays [1]. Gain [3] when you rez Misleading Access Menus.

root.title: Red Herrings
root.rulesText: Runner must pay [5], in addition to any other costs, to steal agendas accessed from this fort, even on the run during which Runner trashes Red Herrings.
